input.command: cd D:\pal; echo "== ALL listening ports (non-system) =="; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Group-Object LocalPort | ForEach-Object { $pr = Get-Process -Id ($_.Group.OwningProcess | Select-Object -First 1) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "$($_.Name) <- $($_.Group.LocalAddress -join ',') [$($pr.ProcessName)]" } | Sort-Object {[int]$_} ; echo "== wsl? =="; (Get-Command wsl -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; echo "== pg-ish processes =="; Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match 'postgres|pg_|psql|postmaster' } | Select-Object Id,ProcessName | Format-Table -AutoSize; echo "== pg data dirs in profile =="; Get-ChildItem -Path "$env:USERPROFILE" -Directory -Filter '*pg*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName
